name: Adelaide Metro tertiary student concession fare
summary: Concession fares on Adelaide buses, trains and trams for full-time, on-site tertiary and university students at approved SA institutions.
who: Full-time, on-site tertiary or university students from approved South Australian institutions
catches: University and tertiary students are not eligible for the cheaper student fare, only the concession fare.
You must carry your concession card whenever you travel on a concession fare.
International student eligibility is not stated on the page.

evidence.claim: Full-time on-site university students at approved SA institutions get concession fares
evidence.quote: Concession fare for full time, on-site, university students from approved South Australian institutions.
You must have your concession card with you whenever you are travelling on a concession fare.

evidence.claim: Uni students get concession, not student, fares
evidence.quote: University and tertiary students are not eligible for a student fare but may be eligible for a concession fare.
